25.4mm Seatpost Diameter

E3 Welding Process ensures the most dependable frame construction possible

Full 4130 chromoly frame w/ double butted top tube

Double butted downtube that is offset butted at the head to create an internal gusset

Internal head tube with CNCed EB logo

Hydroformed monocoque chainstays

Mid BB

Laser cut dropouts

Heat-treated bottom bracket, dropouts and head tube

The classic professional level Nighttrain mountain bike frame from Eastern Bikes. The Night train features an integrated headset and full 4130 chromoly constructed using the E3 Welding Process. Other features include heat-treated drop outs, bottom bracket and head tube with CNC machined Eastern cutout, plus a 25.4mm seatpost diameter which fits our BMX posts and combos.
